subject: MAP: Security gates and DPA timeline for Clearwave PoC
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@clearwave.com>, Priya Sinha <priya.sinha@clearwave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Security gates and DPA timeline for Clearwave PoC

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the product deep-dive last week. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) focused on the compliance gates we discussed. High level ask: can you confirm the items below and whether the proposed timing works for Clearwave so we can lock the PoC start date?

Attachments: map_draft_v0.3.pdf (MAP draft)

MAP highlights (proposed):
- Week 0 (Aug 3): Legal sign-off on DPA redline (Redline attached from our side).
- Week 1 (Aug 6): SOC 2 evidence intake & verification (we’ll validate controls against your report).
- Week 2 (Aug 10): CAIQ/SIG responses complete (we’ll supply clarifying notes and the redlined CAIQ).
- Week 3 (Aug 15): PoC environment & connectivity validated; limited test traffic allowed.
- Week 4 (Aug 25): PoC acceptance / close or identify escalation items.

Open questions for you:
1) Data residency: do you require EU-only processing for any of the PoC datasets, or will US-hosted instances be acceptable for now?
2) Retention windows: proposed default (application logs) = 90 days, full customer data = configurable; does 90 days align with Clearwave policy?
3) SIG/CAIQ: do you have any high-priority control families (e.g., cryptography, key management, logging) we should prioritize in the intake?

If those timelines are fine, I’ll have Laura push the DPA redline and Neha finalize CAIQ comments. Once we have your SOC 2 PDF I’ll kick off the evidence intake.

Next steps: please reply with any changes to the dates or the bullets above by EOD tomorrow and upload your SOC 2 report to the Drive link below.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP: Security gates and DPA timeline for Clearwave PoC

Stephanie —

Thanks for the clear MAP. A few items from our side:

- Timeline: Aug 3 legal sign-off is tight but possible; our counsel will review the redline and aim to respond within 48 hours.
- SOC 2: attaching our most recent report (see attachment). Please note that the report covers our US data centers; for EU-resident customers we have a separate residency addendum — we need clarity if Redwood requires EU processing for any PoC data.
- Retention: 90 days for application logs sounds fine; however, for transaction-level data we need to keep raw traces for 1 year for regulatory purposes. Is Redwood able to configure per-dataset retention policies?
- High-priority CAIQ areas: vendor key management, separation of duties, and incident response timelines — those are the ones our auditors flagged.

We’ll attach the SOC2 report here and Priya is looping in our infra lead if you need deeper technical follow-up.

Alex
Alex Mercer
Head of Infrastructure, Clearwave Financial
alex.mercer@clearwave.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@clearwave.com>, Priya Sinha <priya.sinha@clearwave.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 12:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Security gates and DPA timeline for Clearwave PoC

Hi all —

I reviewed Alex’s note and attached a redline of the DPA. Major points we’ll need to align on quickly:

1) Data residency options: we can offer a US-hosted default for the PoC. If Clearwave requires EU-only processing for specific datasets, we can provision a separate, EU-only instance but that will add ~3–5 business days for networking and routing changes. Please confirm which datasets (by label) need EU residency.

2) Retention windows: we can implement per-dataset retention policies. Proposal: default logs = 90 days; transaction raw traces = 365 days (as requested) with role-based access controls. We’ll add the retention configuration to section 4.3 of the DPA.

3) CAIQ/SIG: Neha and I have drafted inline responses; I’ve attached a redlined CAIQ spreadsheet (redlined_caiq_spreadsheet.xlsx). Neha — can your team validate the controls comments and mark any questions as blockers vs informational?

Proposed immediate actions:
- I will post final DPA redline by EOD tomorrow (Aug 1).
- Neha to complete CAIQ pass by Aug 6.
- Stephanie to coordinate SOC2 validation and evidence intake.

If Clearwave accepts the above, we should be able to keep the PoC start date of Aug 15.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: MAP: Security gates and DPA timeline for Clearwave PoC

Alex / Priya —

Appreciate the quick reply and the SOC 2 — that helps a lot. Summary / agreed changes and next steps:

Agreed items:
- DPA redline review: Redwood legal will file the DPA redline (Laura) by EOD tomorrow (Aug 1).
- Retention: default logs = 90 days; transaction raw traces = 365 days (we’ll document in the DPA, section 4.3).
- Data residency: PoC by default on US-hosted instance. If Clearwave identifies any dataset that must be EU-resident, flag the dataset label by Aug 2 so we can provision an EU instance (3–5 business days lead).
- CAIQ/SIG: Redwood to complete responses by Aug 6.

Revised MAP with dates (short path to close):
- Aug 1: Redwood final DPA redline delivered to Clearwave counsel.
- Aug 3–6: Clearwave legal + Redwood legal finalize DPA.
- Aug 6: CAIQ/SIG pass complete; evidence intake opens.
- Aug 10: SOC2 evidence verification complete (if further requests, we’ll flag).
- Aug 15: PoC environment validated and PoC start (limited traffic).
- Aug 25: PoC acceptance decision / move to production planning.

Please confirm by replying to this thread if the revised MAP looks acceptable. I’ll attach the updated MAP and a DocuSign envelope for the DPA once legal and Clearwave counsel align.

Stephanie
